# Application Security Standards

This directory contains standards for securing application code, configurations, and runtime environments.
page_texts.4:
[standards/security/application/README.md#std-sec-app-001-application-security]

### STD-SEC-APP-001: Application Security

Standards for implementing security controls, practices, and configurations at the application layer including secure coding, dependency management, and runtime protection.
page_texts.5:
[standards/security/application/README.md#purpose]

## Purpose

These standards ensure:
- Secure application development practices
- Consistent security controls across applications
- Protection against common vulnerabilities
- Secure dependency management
- Runtime security monitoring and protection
